Remark
[integral characterizations of Killing fields]

Source: petersen:page-0345 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field 1. ch8:8.4.12Let $X$ be a vector field on a Riemannian manifold.

  1. Show that $|L_Xg|^2=2| abla X|^2+2\operatorname {tr}( abla X\circ abla X)$.

  2. Establish, on a closed oriented Riemannian manifold,

    \[ \int _M\Big(\mathrm{Ric}(X,X)+\operatorname {tr}( abla X\circ abla X)-(\operatorname {div}X)^2\Big)=0, \]

    \[ \int _M\Big(\mathrm{Ric}(X,X)+g(\operatorname {tr} abla ^2X,X)+ frac 12|L_Xg|^2-(\operatorname {div}X)^2\Big)=0. \]

  3. Show that $X$ is a Killing field if and only if $\operatorname {div}X=0$ and $\operatorname {tr} abla ^2X=-\mathrm{Ric}(X)$.
